## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

Describe the commands, tests, or manual checks used to verify the change.

## Trust and security checklist

- [ ] I did not commit passwords, API keys, tokens, private keys, customer data, or production credentials.
- [ ] Authentication and authorization were reviewed for any protected server/API changes.
- [ ] User-controlled input is validated or safely handled where applicable.
- [ ] Database, storage, or migration changes include appropriate ownership/access controls.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary, maintained, and compatible with the repository license.
- [ ] Build/tests relevant to this change pass.
- [ ] Documentation or examples were updated when behavior/configuration changed.
- [ ] Public-facing contact, support, privacy, and security information remains accurate.

## Risk / rollback

Describe any deployment risk and how the change can be rolled back if needed.
